## 题目
Let \(A=\begin{bmatrix}-16&-9&20&-12\\-4&3&5&4\\0&6&0&8\end{bmatrix}\). Find a non-zero vector in the column space of \(A\).

## 解法
This solution uses the matrix method. The column space of \(A\) is the span of the columns of \(A\), so every column of \(A\) lies in \(\operatorname{col}(A)\). Choose the first column of \(A\):
\[
\begin{bmatrix}-16\\-4\\0\end{bmatrix}.
\]
This vector is non-zero.

## 约定
选取 \(A\) 的第 1 列作为所求非零向量。  
来源：自行选取

## 答案
\[
\begin{bmatrix}-16\\-4\\0\end{bmatrix}
\]

## 可核对结论
- 类型：矩阵（列向量）
- 结论：-16 | -4 | 0
- 约定：取 \(A\) 的第 1 列
- 约定来源：自行选取

## 检验
\[
A\begin{bmatrix}1\\0\\0\\0\end{bmatrix}
=
\begin{bmatrix}-16\\-4\\0\end{bmatrix}.
\]
The result is the first column of \(A\), which is non-zero, so it belongs to the column space of \(A\).
